info.sub_ename: PRINCIPLES AND TEACHING OF CHINESE CHARACTERS

description.sub_ename: PRINCIPLES AND TEACHING OF CHINESE CHARACTERS
description.describe_ch: 此門課結合理論與實務，是專門為未來的華語教師設計的課程，旨在探討漢字的本體知識，並掌握漢字教學理論、實踐漢字教學實務。本課程首先介紹漢字的特質、起源、演變、構形等漢字基礎知識，繼而分析漢字的文化闡釋、書寫偏誤、教學理論、方法策略、教案活動設計，並介紹漢字數位教材、工具和資料庫，終而運用漢字教學策略，透過教學實務演練，將漢字理論、教學方法與數位工具應用於實際教學，激發學生學習漢字的興趣與積極度，有效促進漢字學習。
description.describe_eh: This course combines theory and practice and is specifically designed for future Chinese language teachers. It aims to explore the intrinsic knowledge of Chinese characters, master the theories of Chinese character teaching, and practice the teaching of Chinese characters. The course begins with an introduction to the basic knowledge of Chinese characters, including their characteristics, origins, evolution, and structure. It then analyzes the cultural interpretation of Chinese characters, common writing errors, teaching theories, methods, strategies, and lesson plan activities. Additionally, it introduces digital teaching materials, tools, and databases for Chinese characters. Finally, the course applies Chinese character teaching strategies through practical teaching exercises, integrating Chinese character theories, teaching methods, and digital tools into actual teaching to stimulate students' interest and enthusiasm in learning Chinese characters, thereby effectively promoting the learning of Chinese characters.
